channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Amazing Frog?
item.description: Amazing Frog? is an openworld, sandbox, physics game. Grand Frog Auto in Swindon, with farting ragdoll frogs.

item.title: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
item.description: Deploy and merge units into 1,500+ variations to defend your train in tight Turn-Based Strategy battles, then see if your build survives Autobattler journeys between stations against massive monster hordes. Build you crew. Defend the train. Deliver the cargo.

item.title: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard
item.description: Collect hundreds of thousands of golf balls, earn money, buy new tools, and clean up the golf yard. BALL PICKER is an active incremental game centered on the quiet satisfaction of tidying up.

item.title: Crimson Moon
item.description: You are Nephilim: a human-angel hybrid forged to defend humanity with supernatural powers. Fight solo or with a friend to annihilate demons and challenge brutal bosses in relentless melée combat. Rise, violent one. The prophecy is yours to fulfill.

item.title: FATE: Reawakened
item.description: Reawaken the critically acclaimed FATE games like never before! Play all 4 classic dungeon crawler titles with enhanced graphics as you battle through challenging procedurally generated dungeons, learn powerful spells, and fish to your heart’s content. Are you up to the task? Your FATE awaits!

item.title: Goat Simulator 3 - Hocus Pocus Pack
item.description: Just when you thought the Goat Simulator 3 world couldn’t get more enchanting. We’ve added 20 new magical gears to get you brewing with excitement. Sounds wand-erful, right?

item.title: Singularity™
item.description: FIGHT THE PAST TO SAVE THE FUTURE. STOP THE SINGULARITY. Learn the truth behind a massive cover-up of the catastrophic SINGULARITY, an event that fractured time and threatens the world as we know it. Armed with powerful, advanced weaponry and the experimental Time Manipulation Device, fight enemies from the past, the present, and...

item.title: STEEL GULLET
item.description: A physics-driven factory automation game. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on physical properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.

item.title: Below the Stone
item.description: Below the Stone is an extraction roguelike about dwarves on the quest for the deepest depths. A place where each and every descent will lead to new adventures -- and where only the most determined dwarves with many lost lives will be rewarded by the hidden world lying below the stone.

item.title: Dawn of Defense
item.description: Dawn of Defense blends RTS, Tower Defense, and Roguelite progression. In a last defense, lead your tribe against the Empire: Command warriors in battle, fortify defenses, and build an economy as you fight to reclaim your ancestral homeland.

item.title: Goat Simulator 3 - Super Duper Pack
item.description: Is it a bird? Is it a plane? No, it’s the heroes no one asked for. Will they help you save the world? Probably not. More likely the opposite. This super pack contains 20 new gears, 6 with abilities, 6 new instincts, and 2 new playable goats.

item.title: HARMA
item.description: HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. Uncover the truth behind the fallen knights, the burning kingdom, and your missing father. Harness the power of mighty artifacts to defeat demons and save a world on the brink of destruction.

item.title: Link Loop
item.description: Link Loop is a 2D puzzle platformer built around portals and satisfying physics. Use portals to move objects, redirect lasers, and transport fluids. Levels have multiple solutions, and creativity is key.

item.title: Melvor Idle 2: A RuneScape Adventure
item.description: Embark on a brand-new RuneScape idle adventure with Melvor Idle 2. Master iconic RuneScape Skills, face powerful Combat challenges, or uncover the history of the world via Quests, all while enjoying zen-like progression.

item.title: Milki Delivery
item.description: Rebuild a community one bottle at a time in this tiny delivery adventure with your pet cow Milki. Gather resources and upgrade your barn, then bike along dirt paths, breezy meadows, and seaside docks to bring fresh milk back to the sleepy countryside.

item.title: Monkeys!¡
item.description: A romanti-slapstick comedy visual novel from the creative team at HARUKAZE. Saruyoshi, the world's greatest delinquent, must infiltrate the world's most prestigious school for ladies in order to save his boys'-school comrades!

item.title: Clicky Islands
item.description: Clicky Islands is an incremental game with a full city builder inside. Settle procedurally generated islands, build production chains, put your workers to work and ship goods for gold as your economy grows. Unlock permanent upgrades and find the perfect island for His Majesty’s future kingdom

item.title: Func Key
item.description: Func Key is a word-spelling roguelike deckbuilder where your keyboard is your class: six boards, six different ways to play. Spell words, build your board, and bend the rules with mods, all to the soothing thock of the mechanical keyboard.

item.title: GLADIABOTS - AI Combat Arena
item.description: Assemble your robot squad, construct their AI and send them in the battle arena to see your strategy play out. Iterate, improve and repeat until you outsmart all your opponents and friends online.

item.title: Goat Simulator 3 - Multiverse of Nonsense
item.description: "In a world where everything went wrong (and it was all your fault) you must now help the guardian of the Multiverse to save it before it’s too late. This is… Goat Simulator 3: Multiverse of Nonsense"

item.title: Goat Simulator 3 – Baadlands: Furry Road
item.description: Play as Baallistic Pilgor, the antihero and survivor of the apocalypse. Roam around the Baadlands on your motorcycle, butt heads with bizarre rival factions, establish your town and harass its citizens, and try to figure out what’s behind the mysterious vault.

item.title: Here Comes the Horde
item.description: Here Comes the Horde is an incremental auto-battler where your vast armies defend your castle against hordes of undead enemies. Survive the attacks, unlock new units, obtain powerful abilities, and fill the screen with thousands of troops.

item.title: just volleyball
item.description: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!

item.title: Littlelands
item.description: The Littlelands region is brimming with strange characters and magical landscapes to discover if you know where to look, for a big-headed little youngster like you every moment exploring, growing berries, searching for buried treasures or walking through these lands can be an epic adventure.

item.title: Loot Loop
item.description: Build a party of heroes and send them into dungeons in this short incremental RPG. Fight monsters, collect loot, and unlock upgrades. Fast runs, deep skill tree, zero stress.

item.title: Order of the Sinking Star
item.description: From director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness), Order of the Sinking Star is a massive puzzle adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery.

item.title: Rock and Found
item.description: Your Grandma has willed you a collection of rocks deep in the woods, but when you arrive, you find that the rocks are strewn across the floor. Armed with your Grandma's journal, a determination to clean the collection, and the tools she left behind, you begin sorting through thousands of rocks.

item.title: ScopeCreep
item.description: A whispering flame craves souls. With each offering, your resolve strengthens. Fight spirits, collect their essences, and feed a hunger that may never subside in this short active incremental.

item.title: Sol One
item.description: A grounded open-world survival crafting game where you're stranded alone on Mars. Explore the red planet, extract resources, build a pressurized base, manage oxygen, power, and food, and construct the rocket that's your only way home.

item.title: Spirit Crossing
item.description: From the makers of Cozy Grove: Glide through pastel clouds, help lost spirits along the way, and design your own home nestled high on a mountain peak. Befriend strangers around a warm campfire, or share memories while lazily fishing in the sky with a friend. Welcome to your strange new home. 🏠🏔️

item.title: Topdeck Automat
item.description: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself! Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.

item.title: Warpack
item.description: Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, shaped items, commander skills. Forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.
